title: Steering intonational tunes in text-to-speech synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.27403v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-speech systems built on residual vector quantization often generate audio in two stages: a transformer backbone emits the first level of each frame's token stack, and a smaller depth model generates the rest autoregressively. We ask which components of such a model are responsible for prosodic intonation, more precisely for generating the English nuclear tune (for instance, the falling pitch melody that distinguishes an assertion from a question's rising melody), and whether interventions on those components can be used to control intonation. Prompt-based control mostly fails; only a final question mark is a reliable lever. Interchange interventions in CSM and S2 locate the tune: the backbone's hidden state carries it to the waveform through the depth model, and the first level of the stack carries little or none of it. translated_title: 引导文本到语音合成中的语调曲调
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27403v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于残差向量量化构建的文本到语音系统通常分两个阶段生成音频：一个transformer主干网络输出每帧token堆栈的第一层，而一个较小的深度模型自回归地生成其余部分。我们探究这类模型中哪些组件负责韵律语调，更准确地说，负责生成英语核心调（例如，区分陈述句与疑问句上升旋律的下降音高旋律），以及是否可以通过对这些组件的干预来控制语调。基于提示的控制大多失败；只有句末的问号是一个可靠的调节手段。在CSM和S2模型中进行的交换干预定位了语调的来源：主干网络的隐藏状态通过深度模型将语调传递到波形中，而token堆栈的第一层几乎不携带或不携带语调信息。通过使用在以句末（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该研究通过交换干预定位了残差向量量化文本到语音模型中英语核心语调的载体——主干网络的隐藏状态而非token堆栈第一层，并证明可用均值差向量引导该状态来实现对语调的控制。
en_tdlr: Using interchange interventions, this study locates the English nuclear tune in the backbone's hidden state (rather than the first token level) of residual vector quantization TTS models, and shows that steering this state with a difference-of-means vector enables controllable intonation.
